Brand.build: Early on, withstand his damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Brand’s main damage is magic, and Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, slow Brand first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Right after the root, move your cursor toward an ally and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull Brand, who has no mobility ability, toward them.
Brand.laning: Stand to the side of burning minions, as Brand E Conflagration can spread from them. Don’t move up in lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you’re hit by abilities in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge the first ability, especially Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, dodge the Brand Q Sear projectile or hide behind a minion. Stay away from burning allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing to you.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so right after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is your chance to close the gap. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets who are ablaze, so if you aren’t on fire, you don’t need to stop and worry about the stun. If you are ablaze, dodge the Brand Q Sear projectile before engaging.
Brand.fight: When Brand steps forward to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied marksman to get both a shield and a slow. If Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand remains in range, use the slow as an opening to hit Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw him toward your team.
Brand.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so dodge Brand’s abilities in quick succession and use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to support your damage trades. In the late game, focus on protecting allies and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Brand.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline with some distance between allies so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread through your team. Peel off engaging enemies with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on an allied damage dealer who is attacking, then protect them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If enemies engage close enough together to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover and keep allies at a distance so they aren’t left alone beside enemies affected by Berserk.

Blitzcrank.fight: Trade when Blitzcrank has just missed a grab or is low on mana. When the enemy steps forward to last-hit, slow them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding your allied marksman, then briefly apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with a basic attack. Renata Glasc has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t step forward first.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Blitzcrank’s main damage, Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field, is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Blitzcrank.combo: When Blitzcrank steps forward or misses Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, move your cursor, and recast Q to throw him toward your team. If Blitzcrank has reached an ally, throw him in the opposite direction to peel him off.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to move forward. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program then and grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Move behind minions before his grab becomes a threat again.
Blitzcrank.laning: Check bushes with a Control Ward, and stay far away from bushes without vision. Don’t move up the lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and interrupt Blitzcrank’s engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If the enemies who engage are grouped, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other. Watch your positioning so no ally is left alone near enemies affected by Berserk. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer and protect allies with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank can easily follow with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field, so keep your distance with minions between you and him. When you lack vision in a bush, you can’t check his grab range, so stay well away from it. Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so don’t rely solely on the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program when facing him.

Alistar.teamfight: Wait behind your frontline for Alistar to engage, then interrupt him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If you can’t disengage, use Q to apply crowd control again even after Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer and add a shield with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If enemies get close enough to attack each other, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, but keep isolated allies away from enemies affected by Berserk.
Alistar.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Alistar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Alistar P Triumphant Roar keeps undoing your team’s damage, apply Grievous Wounds with a Blighting Jewel.
Alistar.combo: Slow first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Right after the root, move your cursor and recast Q to throw Alistar away from the ally he jumped on. If the thrown Alistar collides with another enemy, that enemy is stunned too.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is a mobility ability, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the gap and grab him. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, then push the lane or reposition before either ability comes back up.
Alistar.fight: Don’t stand forward and start a fight while Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are available. Once both are down, slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and retaliate by grabbing him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and wait out its duration instead of focusing your damage on him.
Alistar.laning: Don’t move up the lane while your E is down.
Alistar.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar closes the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, he can follow with the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample, so keep your distance first. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind and push Renata Glasc under it.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard E Magical Journey can bring him in from the flank, so watch the sides. Keep in mind that you can’t damage targets caught by Bard R Tempered Fate.
Bard.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Bard’s main damage is magic, and the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding can lead to focused attacks, so magic resistance and tenacity matter. If the healing from Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine keeps undoing your team’s damage, apply Grievous Wounds with a Blighting Jewel.
Bard.combo: Slow first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Right after the root, move your cursor and recast Q to throw Bard toward your team; if another enemy is nearby, throw him into them to stun them.
Bard.escape: Right after Bard E Magical Journey is used is your window to grab him. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, close the gap and hit him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake after slowing him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Bard.fight: When Bard steps forward to last-hit, slow and damage him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding your allied marksman. If Bard E Magical Journey is down, close the gap and look to grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on the ally who will deal damage just before a fight.
Bard.laning: Briefly apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark to the enemy marksman with a basic attack to help your ally trade damage.
Bard.phase: In the mid game, you can counter enemies engaging as a group with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, but alert other lanes when Bard leaves lane, since he may appear there. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Bard.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and watch for Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun angles and flanks through Bard E Magical Journey. Right after the enemy team engages as a group, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, and don’t leave an ally alone near enemies affected by Berserk. Interrupt engages with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and protect your damage dealers with Renata Glasc W Bailout and E Loyalty Program.

Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no mobility ability, so grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake when your ally approaches by going around his turret setup.
Heimerdinger.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so don’t hold your ground and fight in front of Heimerdinger’s turret setup; use shields to help your ally trade damage. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Heimerdinger.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: If Q hits, move your cursor toward an ally, then recast to throw Heimerdinger.
Heimerdinger.laning: Renata Glasc shouldn’t stand forward early. Cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied marksman to aim for both a shield and a slow. Trade briefly when Heimerdinger steps forward to last-hit, and don’t move forward while E is down. Apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with one basic attack when it’s safe.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline, interrupt enemy engages with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before a fight. Protect allies and slow enemies with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If enemies engage close together, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, but don’t leave an ally alone near enemies affected by Berserk.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing indicator, move sideways to avoid the center; if it hits you, get out of turret range.

Seraphine.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Seraphine.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Seraphine’s damage is magic and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Seraphine W Surround Sound keeps healing back your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately move your cursor and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake; if your allies need to close in, throw Seraphine toward them. If the fight calls for saving an ally, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then follow with the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility skill, so the moment after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is your window to engage. Slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake to make it difficult for her to create distance. If Renata Glasc is slowed, move out of the straight line first so Seraphine E Beat Drop cannot root you next.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the gap. When Seraphine is alone and away from an allied ranged damage dealer, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Renata Glasc has no skill to escape on her own, so do not overextend while Seraphine E Beat Drop is still available.
Seraphine.laning: When Seraphine steps forward to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied carry to gain both a shield and a slow. While Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down, do not step forward; just apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with a quick auto attack.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side so Seraphine R Encore cannot reach far by chaining through your allies, and position Renata Glasc behind your frontline. If the enemy team engages together, hit enemies grouped close enough to attack each other with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Stop engages with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and protect your allied damage dealers with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets, so if you are slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine Q High Note deals more damage based on missing health, so be more careful when your health is low. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits a champion, so do not line up with your allies.

Braum.build: Early on, withstand Braum’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc has no ability to escape on her own, so tenacity is also important to counter the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows.
Braum.combo: When Braum E Unbreakable is down, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Braum has reached an ally, recast Q to peel him off; if your ally can catch him, throw him toward them. Move your cursor in the direction you want to throw him before recasting.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used is your window to close the gap and grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Braum E Unbreakable is down too, look for an angle to hit him with the projectile. If Braum Q Winter’s Bite or a basic attack marks you, stop your engage and get out of range.
Braum.fight: When Braum moves toward your allied marksman, shield your ally and slow Braum with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Look for a chance to grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used. If Braum E Unbreakable is active, wait for his shield to lower or look for an angle from the side his shield isn’t facing.
Braum.laning: Dodge Braum Q Winter’s Bite from behind minions, and when the enemy steps forward to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied marksman. Don’t move up the lane while E is down.
Braum.phase: Once you’ve learned Renata Glasc Q Handshake, look for a kill opportunity when Braum steps forward or Braum W Stand Behind Me is down.
Braum.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and interrupt Braum’s engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer. Right after Braum and the enemies engage, if they’re close enough to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Don’t leave an ally alone near enemies affected by Berserk, and dodge the line and lingering slow zone from Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter’s Bite or a basic attack applies the mark from Braum P Concussive Blows, get out of range before more stun stacks build up. Dodge Braum Q Winter’s Bite from behind minions, and move sideways out of its line when you see the cast animation for Braum R Glacial Fissure. Don’t throw Renata Glasc Q Handshake in the direction where Braum E Unbreakable is active.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Hwei’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: Hit the slow from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program first, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Right after the root, move your cursor toward an ally and recast Q to pull Hwei toward them.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so closing the gap right after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment creates a chance to grab him. If his E is still available, check that it has been used before engaging, since it can force an engaging ally back or root them.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to fight. Slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and shield your ally, then grab Hwei with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw him toward your team.
Hwei.laning: Hit Hwei with E when he steps forward to last-hit, and briefly apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with a basic attack. Don’t move up the lane while E is down.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Hwei.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and watch for Hwei E Subject: Torment to be used, then grab Hwei with Renata Glasc Q Handshake or interrupt the enemy’s engage. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer and shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Right after the enemy team engages together, hit enemies who are close enough to attack each other with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s root or pull, it becomes hard to dodge the follow-up damage. If you’re hit by Hwei’s first ability, reposition immediately to dodge the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Janna.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Janna deals mostly magic damage, prioritize magic resistance. If Janna R Monsoon keeps healing allies and undoing your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel early to apply Grievous Wounds.
Janna.combo: Slow first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor toward an ally and recast to pull Janna toward them. If you throw her into another enemy, that enemy is stunned too.
Janna.escape: The window to engage opens after Janna Q Howling Gale misses. If Janna R Monsoon is also down, there’s less risk of being pushed away, so slow Janna with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and follow up with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Janna.fight: Don’t pile damage onto a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Deplete the shield, then fight. When Janna Q Howling Gale misses and Janna R Monsoon is down, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Janna.laning: Renata Glasc should stay back early. When an ally protected by Janna steps up to last-hit, use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to deal damage and slow them while shielding your ally. Deplete Janna E Eye Of The Storm’s shield, then add a Renata Glasc P Leverage mark with a short auto attack to help your ally trade. Don’t step forward in lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Janna.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Janna.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to separate an engaging enemy from your allies. Help your main damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Just after enemies group up to engage, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, but don’t leave an ally alone near enemies affected by Berserk. Janna R Monsoon can push away an engage, so look for a chance to catch her when she’s far away or after she uses it.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can knock you up, so move out of its path if you hear the tornado from a bush or out of vision. Janna R Monsoon can push away an ally who engages, so don’t overcommit when it’s available.

Karma.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance while keeping enough distance to break Karma W Focused Resolve’s tether. If healing from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma W Focused Resolve keeps undoing your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Karma.combo: If Karma steps forward and Karma W Focused Resolve is down, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then hit Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor toward an ally and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull Karma toward them. If another enemy is nearby, throw Karma into them to stun the enemy she collides with too.
Karma.escape: The window to catch Karma opens after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma E Inspire has also ended, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and follow up with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Renata Glasc has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is available.
Karma.fight: When Karma steps up to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your ranged carry to use its shield and slow together. Catch Karma with Renata Glasc Q Handshake after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma E Inspire has ended. Renata Glasc has no way to escape on her own, so don’t walk forward first.
Karma.laning: Briefly auto attack the enemy ranged carry to apply a Renata Glasc P Leverage mark, then have an ally attack that target. Don’t step forward in lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Karma.phase: Early on, Renata Glasc has low health and attack damage, so it’s better to survive by avoiding Karma’s poke. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Karma.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and wait for Karma W Focused Resolve to go down, then use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop an enemy engage or throw an enemy damage dealer toward your allies. Just before a fight, use Renata Glasc W Bailout on an ally who will deal damage, then add a shield with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When enemies engage together and are close enough to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Keep nearby isolated allies away from enemies affected by Berserk.
Karma.watch: Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma Q Inner Flame deals damage again after a short delay at the impact point, so move out of the area if it hits you. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you. Repeatedly getting hit by Karma’s abilities also reduces Karma R Mantra’s cooldown, so avoid poke behind minions or outside her range.

Leona.build: Survive with an early Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Renata Glasc has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first against her. After that, choose further resistances based on the damage type of the enemy carry who will attack while Leona has you locked down.
Leona.combo: When Leona approaches or after she uses Leona E Zenith Blade, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Leona has jumped onto an ally, move your cursor in the direction you want to pull her away, then recast Q. When an ally is in danger, use Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then follow with the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Leona.escape: Only close the distance to counterattack immediately after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, and catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake so she can’t get away. Renata Glasc has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t let Leona get into engage range while her crowd control is available.
Leona.fight: The moment after Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your chance to counterattack. If an ally is caught by Leona, root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, then recast to pull her away from your ally. For regular trades, slow enemies with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding an ally, and briefly add a Renata Glasc P Leverage mark with an auto attack.
Leona.laning: Use E when the enemy steps up to last-hit, and don’t step forward while E is down. Leona has high armor early, so chip away at her health with ranged poke instead of starting a fight with physical damage, then counterattack after her engage ability is down.
Leona.phase: Early on, Renata Glasc is weak, and Leona’s engage and high armor are threatening, so manage your distance and the timing of Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and wait for Leona to engage, then stop her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and support your damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When Leona engages together with allies and they get close to each other, hit the group with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other. Watch that no ally is left alone near enemies affected by Berserk, and retreat immediately if a Leona P Sunlight mark is applied.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and dashes to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your ranged carry. Leona can approach with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak already activated, so watch the distance she can engage from rather than whether she has used the ability. When Leona R Solar Flare’s indicator appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun. When Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its area before it explodes.

Lulu.build: Survive with an early Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Renata Glasc has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu steps forward, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Follow up with Renata Glasc Q Handshake to root her, then move your cursor in the direction you want to throw her and recast Q. Throw her toward your allies if they need to engage; if enemies are grouped, throw her into them to stun enemies hit by the collision.
Lulu.escape: The moment after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally is your chance to approach Lulu. She has no dash to escape, so close the distance and catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Lulu E Help, Pix!’s shield and Pix are on the allied carry, you may also get a chance to target Lulu herself.
Lulu.fight: When Lulu steps forward to last-hit, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding an ally. Look for a chance to close in and catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake after Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another ally. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target someone else instead of investing heavily in the protected target.
Lulu.laning: Early on, Renata Glasc should stay back and avoid the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion by standing behind minions. Support your ally’s trades with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, and briefly mark the enemy ranged carry with an auto attack. Don’t step forward in lane while E is down, and keep poking consistently.
Lulu.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop an enemy engage. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Don’t assume you can kill a target while Lulu R Wild Growth is available; target Lulu herself or someone else. When enemies engage together and are close enough to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover and move nearby isolated allies out of the Berserk area.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy disables your abilities and attacks, so don’t close the distance first while it’s available. Lulu R Wild Growth can immediately save its target and knock up nearby enemies, so don’t dive deep expecting a kill on a target while R is available. Watch out for the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance too, and remember that Renata Glasc has no ability to escape on her own.

Lux.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Lux’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for magic resistance and tenacity.
Lux.combo: Slow first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor toward an ally and recast Q to pull Lux toward them. If Lux is grouped with another enemy, throw her into them to stun the enemy she collides with too.
Lux.escape: Close the distance immediately after baiting out and dodging Lux Q Light Binding. Lux has no mobility ability, so if you get close, catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Lux.fight: The chance to fight comes after you dodge Lux Q Light Binding. When an enemy steps up to last-hit, use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to slow and damage them while shielding an ally. If you get an angle to reach Lux, catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw her toward your allies.
Lux.laning: Stand off to the side so Lux Q Light Binding can’t pass through an ally and hit you too. Don’t step forward while E is down, and only add a brief auto attack mark when it’s safe.
Lux.phase: In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Lux.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and leave space between yourself and your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you all together. Use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to separate an approaching enemy, then cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before a fight and help them with the E shield. When enemies group up close to engage, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, but don’t leave an ally alone near enemies affected by Berserk.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to two targets, so don’t stand in a line with an ally. It can easily lead into follow-up abilities if it hits, so bait out and dodge Q. If you are hit by an ability, get out of Lux’s auto attack range to prevent the Illumination mark from detonating. Dodge sideways when Lux R Final Spark’s red targeting line appears.

Maokai.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Maokai’s main damage, and get tenacity to deal with his roots. If healing from Maokai P Sap Magic keeps undoing your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Maokai.combo: Slow the enemy carry first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root them with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. When recasting Q, move your cursor and throw the enemy toward your allies. If Maokai has jumped onto an ally, pull him away from them. Don’t use Q during Maokai W Twisted Advance; wait until he lands.
Maokai.escape: The moment after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down is your window to close in and fight. Don’t dive in first while Maokai W Twisted Advance or Maokai R Nature's Grasp is ready.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, and trade just after it’s down. Slow the enemy carry with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding an ally, then follow with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Maokai.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so manage your distance and check whether Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is available as you lane. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline in open terrain, and move to the side when Maokai R Nature's Grasp approaches. After Maokai engages, stop him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Cast Renata Glasc W Bailout first on an ally who is dealing damage, then protect them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When enemies engage together close enough to attack each other, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, and Maokai can’t be targeted during the dash, so respond with Renata Glasc Q Handshake after he lands. Don’t enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has been placed. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp approaches from far away, dodge at a right angle to its direction of travel.
Maokai.laning: Cast E so its effects overlap when the enemy carry steps up to last-hit, and don’t step forward while E is down. Repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities brings Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing back sooner, so focus your poke on the enemy carry.

Milio.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio deals magic damage, but his own damage is low, so choose further resistances based on the enemy carry’s damage type. If Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life keep healing allies and undoing your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel early to apply Grievous Wounds.
Milio.combo: Slow the enemy first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then hit Renata Glasc Q Handshake to root them. If you can catch Milio, move your cursor toward your allies and recast Q to throw him. If Milio is grouped with enemies, throw him into them to stun enemies hit by the collision too.
Milio.escape: Engage during the window when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down. Milio has no mobility ability, so close the distance and catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Milio.fight: When an enemy steps up to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your ranged carry to shield them and slow the enemy at the same time. Once Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, you have a chance to close in. Catch Milio with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw him toward your allies.
Milio.laning: Briefly apply a Renata Glasc P Leverage mark to the enemy ranged carry with an auto attack, and don’t step forward while E is down. Use early trades to drain Milio’s mana and take control of the wave.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, so take control of the wave early, then keep allies alive and disrupt the enemy team in the late game.
Milio.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop an enemy engage or throw an enemy damage dealer toward your allies. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Just after enemies group up and engage together, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, and keep nearby isolated allies away from enemies affected by Berserk.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage and knocks back the first enemy it hits, so don’t force your way in before he uses it. When the enemy ranged carry attacks from the extended range of Milio W Cozy Campfire, hold off on engaging the frontline and wait out its duration.

Morgana.build: Survive with an early Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Morgana deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If Morgana keeps recovering the damage your team deals through Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow, buy Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, slow the enemy first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root them with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor in the direction you want to throw them and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull them toward your allies or away from them. When you need to save an ally, use Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Morgana.escape: The chance to close in comes when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Slow the enemy with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then catch them with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If you’re caught by Morgana R Soul Shackles, move out of range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.fight: After dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding, use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program when an enemy steps up to last-hit to slow and damage them while shielding an ally. If Morgana E Black Shield is active, don’t use Renata Glasc Q Handshake; wait until the shield is down before looking for a root. Renata Glasc can’t escape on her own, so keep your distance as you fight.
Morgana.laning: Stay back early and keep a minion between you and Morgana to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your ranged carry to shield them and slow the enemy, and only apply a Renata Glasc P Leverage mark with an auto attack when it’s safe. Don’t step forward in lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Morgana.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and help your ally trade with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive and disrupting the enemy team rather than dealing damage yourself.
Morgana.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, and create distance before the stun if Morgana R Soul Shackles reaches you. Use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull away an enemy who jumps onto an ally, and support your main damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When enemies engage together and get close enough to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover and move isolated allies out of those enemies' attack range.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will follow, so move with minions between you and Morgana. When your health is low, don’t retreat over Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles chains you, move out of range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow keeps undoing your allies' damage, buy a Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Nami.combo: After Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to throw Nami toward your allies. If an enemy is behind Nami, throw her into them to stun that enemy too.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility ability, so right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the distance. You can also go in after dodging Nami R Tidal Wave sideways, but keep watching for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow.
Nami.fight: Go after Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Nami has no mobility ability, so once you close the distance, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Do not step forward while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Nami.laning: When Nami steps forward, combine the damage and slow from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then safely apply Renata Glasc P Leverage's mark with a basic attack. Use Renata Glasc Q Handshake when Nami steps forward or there is space between the minions.
Nami.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so fight while keeping your distance and tracking whether Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is available. Later, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Nami.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and watch for Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave, using Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop the enemy's engage. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on the ally who will deal damage, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When enemies engage and get close together, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and do not leave an ally alone beside enemies affected by Berserk.
Nami.watch: If Nami Q Aqua Prison hits you, you are stunned. If Nami R Tidal Wave hits you, you are slowed and knocked up, and may then be hit by a follow-up combo. Walk sideways to dodge when you see either ability coming. Do not fight head-on against an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; keep your distance until the effect ends.

Nautilus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus deals mostly magic damage, and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.combo: After Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to throw Nautilus toward your allies or away from them.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your window to close the distance and catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. After the trade, move away before Nautilus P Staggering Blow can hit you with a basic attack.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, keep your distance and trade with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to slow him and shield an ally at the same time. If Nautilus engages on an ally, catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and pull him away from them.
Nautilus.laning: Stay behind minions rather than in front, and watch for Nautilus Q Dredge Line. When the enemy steps up to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied ranged carry to slow the enemy and shield your ally. Do not step forward while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down.
Nautilus.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so dodge Nautilus Q Dredge Line and support your allies' trades with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Once you learn Renata Glasc Q Handshake, you can look for a kill when Nautilus's engage ability is down.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Nautilus's engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, and cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before they fight. Follow up with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to protect your allies. When the enemies dive together and get close enough to attack each other, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and do not leave an ally alone beside enemies affected by Berserk.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and kill setup, so dodge it with minions between you. If Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you with his first basic attack, you are likely to get hit by his follow-up abilities too, so stay out of basic attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, position so its path does not overlap with your allies.

Pantheon.build: Buy armor items first to prepare for Pantheon's main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon steps forward, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then hit him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Pantheon jumps onto an ally, move your cursor away from that ally and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull him off.
Pantheon.escape: Do not engage first before Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. Before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again, look for a chance to slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon steps up to last-hit, use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to slow and damage him while shielding an ally. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage, do not cast abilities from in front; wait for it to end.
Pantheon.laning: Reduce Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke by keeping minions between you, and do not step up in lane when Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is unavailable.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and stop Pantheon's engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake or pull him away from an ally. If Pantheon and the other enemies engage together and get close enough to attack each other, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Do not leave an ally alone beside enemies affected by Berserk, and cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before the fight.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so it is hard to dodge if you let him get in range. Take Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke with minions between you, and walk out of the landing area when you see the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall.

Pyke.build: If healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones keeps undoing your allies' damage, buy a Blighting Jewel first to apply Grievous Wounds. Against Pyke's main damage, prioritize armor over magic resistance, and keep enough health to stay above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.combo: Slow Pyke first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Pyke has engaged on an ally, move your cursor in the direction you want to pull him away and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake. When an ally is in danger, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then follow with the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Pyke.escape: Right after sidestepping the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow is your chance to counterattack. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down and has not come off cooldown yet, catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and fight alongside your allies. If only Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down, keep your distance while accounting for his remaining mobility.
Pyke.fight: When Pyke steps forward to last-hit, slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and shield an ally. If Pyke engages first, catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and pull him away from your allies. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow, check his remaining mobility before continuing the fight.
Pyke.laning: Do not step forward in lane while Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down. When Pyke retreats to heal, keep track of him with wards or vision, and block his Pyke W Ghostwater Dive approach with a Control Ward.
Pyke.phase: Later, keep your allies behind your frontline and move together, focusing on protection and disrupting the enemy formation.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and stop Pyke's engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer. If the enemies engage together, check whether they are close enough to attack each other before using Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Do not stand beside low-health allies, so you do not get caught with them in Pyke R Death From Below's range.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Renata Glasc has a hard time escaping on her own, so keep your distance. When you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, retreat toward an ally or turret. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move sideways out of its dash path to avoid the stun.

Rakan.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rakan deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, while keeping in mind that the main threat is the engage opened by Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness.
Rakan.combo: After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If Q hits, move your cursor and recast it to pull Rakan toward your allies or pull him off an ally he has engaged on.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance is down is your chance to close the distance and hit him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Also look for a moment when Rakan is moving alone, away from his allies, since he cannot dash to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance then.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. If you dodge Rakan W Grand Entrance, slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Rakan.laning: Early on, do not stand in front; support your allies' trades with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. When the enemy steps up to last-hit, cast E past your allied ranged carry to aim for both a shield and a slow, and briefly apply Renata Glasc P Leverage's mark with a basic attack. Do not step forward while E is down.
Rakan.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so hold your ground while keeping your distance and tracking whether Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is available. Later, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Rakan.teamfight: Cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before they fight, and protect them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If the enemies dive together and get close to one another, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and move isolated allies out of range of attacks from enemies affected by Berserk.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance dashes in and knocks you up at the landing point, so move sideways when Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, do not stand in a line; stop him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake before he reaches you or use terrain to keep him away.

Rell.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity also matters because Renata Glasc is easy to hit with follow-up attacks once caught.
Rell.combo: Slow Rell first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after the root, move your cursor and recast to pull Rell away from your allies. After Rell Q Shattering Strike is down, support your allies with the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Rell.escape: Right after Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down misses, back away and deal with the slowed Rell. If Rell only used Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, she can escape with Rell E Full Tilt, so do not dive in immediately. The moment to chase is when you hit Rell with Renata Glasc Q Handshake before Rell E Full Tilt is available again.
Rell.fight: From outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range, use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to slow and damage Rell while shielding an ally. If Rell dives in, catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw her away from your allies. Look for a chance to root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and fight before Rell E Full Tilt is available again.
Rell.laning: When Rell or the enemy ranged carry steps up to last-hit, hit them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and briefly apply a basic attack mark from a safe distance. Do not step forward if Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down or you see the engage signal from Rell E Full Tilt.
Rell.phase: Renata Glasc is weak early, so keep your distance from Rell's engage range while poking. Later, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than stepping forward.
Rell.teamfight: Before the engage, spread out from your allies so several of you are not pulled together by Rell R Magnet Storm. Stay behind your frontline and stop Rell's engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, then cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on your main damage dealer just before the fight. If Rell and the other enemies engage together, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, and do not leave an ally alone in their attack range.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally, that signals an engage. When Rell runs toward you, stop trading and retreat out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so dodge it sideways and use the shield from Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program afterward.

Senna.build: Build armor first since most of Senna’s damage is physical. Senna P Absolution deals damage based on your current health, so build armor along with health instead of stacking health alone. If Senna Q Piercing Darkness keeps healing back your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel early to apply Grievous Wounds.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps forward, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then hit her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake to root her. Move your cursor toward your allies and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull Senna in that direction. If the thrown Senna collides with another enemy, that enemy is also stunned, so also watch the direction where opponents are grouped.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses is your chance to close the gap while avoiding its root. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed, but she has no skill to create distance on her own, so if you have closed the gap, catch her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to last-hit or collect a soul, slow her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and shield your allied carry. If Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program hits and gives you a chance to close the gap, root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw her toward your allies. Renata Glasc should look for this angle from behind her allies instead of stepping forward to engage.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls appear in advance and use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to harass Senna when she comes to collect them, preventing her from collecting them. Avoid the straight path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and stand behind minions to help block Senna W Last Embrace. While Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down, do not step forward; only apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with an auto attack when it is safe.
Senna.phase: Early on, both champions have low health and attack damage, so Renata Glasc should stay back, trade with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, and deny Senna Mist collection. Later, as Senna’s attack range and attack damage grow, Renata Glasc should focus on protecting allies and disrupting the enemy formation.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, fall back to a location with vision or cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program into the mist to deter her approach. Renata Glasc should stay behind her frontline and stop engages with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, then empower the main damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout just before a fight. If enemies engage while grouped close together, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, but keep nearby allies out of the frenzied enemies’ attack range.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through allies or minions, so avoid the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace roots the target it hits and nearby enemies after a brief delay, so immediately move away from allies if you are marked. If Senna hits you once, back off to deny her Mist collection rather than letting her attack you a second time.

Sona.build: Sona deals mostly magic damage, and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance keeps undoing your allies' damage, buy a Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If you have an angle to pull Sona toward your allies, move your cursor that way and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Sona.escape: Decide whether to chase before Sona E Song of Celerity is activated. If you stop Sona's movement with Renata Glasc Q Handshake when she steps forward, it will be difficult for her to escape using only the movement speed from Sona E Song of Celerity. If Sona R Crescendo is available, avoid an engage angle that lines Sona and your allies up.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to last-hit or deliver an aura, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied ranged carry to get a shield and deal damage while slowing the enemy. Briefly apply Renata Glasc P Leverage's mark, and catch Sona with Renata Glasc Q Handshake when an opening appears.
Sona.phase: Sona gets stronger as the game goes on, so hold onto your early advantage and focus on protecting allies and disrupting the enemy formation later.
Sona.teamfight: Stand spread out to either side of your allies so Sona R Crescendo does not stun several of you, and watch for Sona to step forward. From behind your frontline, use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull Sona away from the allied group so her aura cannot reach, or to stop the enemy's engage. If the enemies are close enough to attack each other right after engaging together, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and support your damage dealers with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Sona.watch: If Sona steps into basic attack range as though Sona P Power Chord is ready, move away; depending on the ability she used just before, it can empower her damage or slow you. When Sona steps forward, watch for Sona R Crescendo, and do not stand in a line with your allies.

Soraka.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Soraka’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance. If Soraka’s healing keeps healing back your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel to apply Grievous Wounds.
Soraka.combo: Slow Soraka first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately move your cursor toward your allies and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to pull Soraka in. If Soraka is close to another enemy, throw her that way to stun the enemy she collides with too.
Soraka.escape: The moment after Soraka uses E Equinox on harass or the wave is your window to engage. Also dodge Soraka Q Starcall so you do not allow her slow and movement speed increase.
Soraka.fight: Use the moment Soraka E Equinox is down as your chance to engage. While your allied carry attacks, shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while damaging and slowing Soraka, then bind her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Focus damage on Soraka herself instead of continuing to hit enemies who are receiving her healing.
Soraka.laning: When the enemy steps forward to last-hit, hit them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, and apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with an auto attack only when it is safe. Pressure your allied carry to force Soraka to use W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall to prevent Soraka from healing.
Soraka.phase: After learning Renata Glasc Q Handshake, you can look for a kill opening when Soraka E Equinox is down.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop engages or throw Soraka toward your allies. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on an allied damage dealer who is dealing damage, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If the enemy engages at close enough range to attack each other, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover and keep your allies away from the frenzied enemies.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, it slows you while healing Soraka and granting her movement speed, so dodge it. Inside Soraka E Equinox’s area, you are silenced and may be rooted, so use your skills before stepping into it. Soraka R Wish heals her allies, so do not let trades that only chip away at their health drag on.

Taric.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Taric’s magic damage and choose Mercury’s Treads. If the enemy’s healing keeps healing back your team’s damage, buy Blighting Jewel first to apply Grievous Wounds.
Taric.combo: Slow Taric first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately move your cursor in the direction you want to throw him and recast; if Taric is grouped with another enemy, throw him that way to stun them. If an ally is in danger, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Taric.escape: After Taric E Dazzle is down is your chance to pressure him. Taric has no skill to create distance on his own, so bind him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake when you get an opening.
Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle, then trade while keeping your distance. When Taric steps forward to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied carry to use its shield and slow together. Keep your distance so Taric cannot get close enough to auto attack.
Taric.laning: While Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down, do not step forward in lane. Do not allow Taric to trade at close range, and reduce his chances to auto attack while standing near the minion wave.
Taric.phase: Early on, Renata Glasc is weak and Taric’s melee auto attack damage is threatening, so keep your distance and harass him. Later, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation.
Taric.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, watch Taric E Dazzle and the linked ally's stun range, and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop engages. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to keep targets rooted, then resume dealing damage after the immunity ends. When enemies engage together, use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, and keep nearby allies out of the frenzied area.
Taric.watch: When you see the warning for Taric E Dazzle, sidestep to dodge it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to apply a root while waiting out its duration.

Thresh.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Thresh’s ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity is also important in situations where getting caught leads to follow-up damage from allied champions.
Thresh.combo: If Thresh steps forward and you dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence, or if Thresh W Dark Passage is down, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Move your cursor, then recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to throw him toward your allies or peel him off an ally he has engaged.
Thresh.escape: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down and has not become available again, he will have a harder time escaping when you bind him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Move out of the line between Thresh and his ally so you can avoid the forced movement from Thresh E Flay.
Thresh.fight: When Thresh steps forward to collect a soul, slow and damage him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while shielding your ally. After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the gap, but keep in mind that Thresh can escape if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available.
Thresh.laning: Early on, Renata Glasc should stay back and support her ally’s trades with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Briefly auto attack the enemy carry to apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark, and trade when Thresh steps forward to collect a soul. While Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down, do not step forward in lane.
Thresh.phase: Early on, Renata Glasc is weak, so keep your distance and endure; start looking for opportunities after learning Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Later, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Thresh.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to stop Thresh’s engage or separate an engaging enemy from your allies. Just before a fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on the main damage dealer, and protect your allies with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. After enemies engage while grouped together, hit them with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover to make them attack each other, but keep nearby isolated allies out of that area.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence is especially dangerous because after hooking you, Thresh can follow up with a dash. Move sideways when you see him raise his hook, and change direction once more when stepping forward to last-hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay cannot pull you toward them.

Velkoz.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to counter Vel’Koz’s main damage, but you cannot block the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray with resistance, so avoid being hit by successive skills.
Velkoz.combo: After Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, slow him first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately move your cursor toward your allies and recast Renata Glasc Q Handshake to throw Vel’Koz.
Velkoz.escape: Vel’Koz has no mobility skill, so the moment after dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your chance to close the gap. Slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, but keep in mind that if you get very close, Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back.
Velkoz.fight: When Vel’Koz steps forward to last-hit, slow and damage him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program while protecting your allied ranged damage dealer. After Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, hit Vel’Koz, who has no mobility ability, with Renata Glasc Q Handshake to root him and throw him toward your allies. Just before the fight, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on an ally who will deal damage.
Velkoz.laning: When Vel’Koz steps forward to last-hit, slow him, and apply Renata Glasc P Leverage’s mark with an auto attack only when it is safe. While Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program is down, do not step forward in lane.
Velkoz.phase: In the late game, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Velkoz.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and prioritize interrupting Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray with Renata Glasc Q Handshake when it begins. Cast Renata Glasc W Bailout on the main damage dealer just before the fight, and cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied damage dealers to aim for both a shield and a slow. If enemies engage while grouped closely enough to attack each other, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and do not leave an ally alone beside frenzied enemies.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission splits during flight and hits both sides, so stay alert even after dodging the initial shot sideways. If Vel’Koz W Void Rift and Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption also hit in succession, the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction detonates; if stacks have built up, back away and let them expire. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize interrupting it with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.

Xerath.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the damage and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Xerath’s damage is magic and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Slow Xerath first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately move your cursor and recast, throwing Xerath toward your allies to close the gap.
Xerath.escape: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility skill, so close the gap then and catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Xerath.fight: When Xerath steps forward to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied damage dealer to gain both a shield and a slow. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close the gap and catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Xerath.laning: Early on, do not step forward; support your allies’ trades with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Endure while dodging Xerath’s heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler during the period when mana runs dry.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and stop the enemy’s engage with Renata Glasc Q Handshake, then help your allied damage dealers with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover when enemies are close enough to attack each other, and do not leave an ally alone beside frenzied enemies.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, change your direction and move sideways. If you are stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you are likely to take follow-up attacks, so be especially careful of that shot.

Zilean.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads. Zilean deals magic damage, and getting caught by bomb stuns and Zilean E Time Warp’s slow is dangerous, so Tenacity is the first benefit you’ll feel. If Zilean’s healing keeps undoing your team’s damage, buy a Blighting Jewel early to apply Grievous Wounds.
Zilean.combo: Slow first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program, then root with Renata Glasc Q Handshake. Immediately after rooting Zilean, move your cursor toward your allies and recast to pull him in that direction. If Zilean is near another enemy, throw him toward that enemy to stun the enemy he collides with as well.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so close the distance when the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp are down. Once you’re close, slow him with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program and grab him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Zilean.fight: When Zilean steps up to last-hit, cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied damage dealer to provide a shield and slow. When Zilean’s crowd control is down, look for a chance to catch him with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw him toward your team. If an opponent is affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, wait for its duration to end or be ready to engage again as soon as they revive.
Zilean.laning: Use Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to support your ally’s trades, then apply a mark with a quick basic attack.
Zilean.teamfight: From behind your frontline, use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to interrupt the enemy’s engage, and help your allied damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. If the enemies engage close enough to hit one another, counter with Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover. Move nearby isolated allies out of the berserk area. If it’s hard to finish an enemy affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, switch your target to Zilean himself, since he has no mobility and is fragile.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach to the same target. Enemies affected by Zilean R Chronoshift cannot be targeted while reviving, so don’t use abilities on them then.

Zyra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Renata Glasc has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Zyra.combo: After Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, slow her first with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Follow with Renata Glasc Q Handshake to root her, move your cursor toward an ally, then recast to throw Zyra. If you need to save an ally, cast Renata Glasc W Bailout first, then shield them with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no mobility, so after dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to close the distance. Check that there are no plants nearby, then land Renata Glasc Q Handshake after slowing her with Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Renata Glasc also has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t engage while Zyra’s root is still available.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots and trade when there are no plants nearby. Cast Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program past your allied damage dealer to shield them while damaging and slowing Zyra. If Zyra comes close, grab her with Renata Glasc Q Handshake and throw her toward your team.
Zyra.laning: When Zyra steps up to last-hit, overlap Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program with her, and don’t step forward while abilities are down. Step on Zyra’s seeds to destroy them when no ability is flying toward you.
Zyra.phase: In the late game, focus on saving allies and disrupting the enemy formation rather than dealing damage yourself as Renata Glasc.
Zyra.teamfight: Don’t fight where Zyra has set up plants; move the fight elsewhere. From behind your frontline, use Renata Glasc Q Handshake to interrupt engages, and help your allied damage dealer with Renata Glasc W Bailout and Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program. Use Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover when the enemies dive in together and get close enough to attack one another. Move nearby isolated allies out of the berserk area.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, you’re likely to be hit by Zyra’s plants and then knocked up by Zyra R Stranglethorns. Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots by moving sideways near its maximum range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area. Don’t fight where there are lots of plants; back off briefly.
